claims.claim: Ukrainian forces struck over 30 air defence, radar, and electronic warfare assets, over 40 command posts, and over 50 logistics facilities in September, including S-400 launchers, a 92N6 radar, Buk-M3 SAMs, Pantsir-S1 and Pantsir-S2 systems, Nebo-U, Nebo-SV, Podlyot, Kasta, and P-18 radar stations.
Ukrainian defence forces struck more than 20 Russian drone storage, preparation, production, and deployment facilities in September.
Ukrainian forces struck a railway bridge across the North Crimean Canal used for military logistics in Crimea during September.
Ukrainian forces struck a Su-24, a MiG-29, a Ka-27 helicopter, a BK-16 landing boat, and a Mongoose patrol boat.
Russian strikes caused widespread damage to Ukraine's power grid and electricity transmission facilities.
Ukrainian forces achieved results in eliminating Russian infiltration attempts in Dobropillya.
Russian Vostok group artillery struck camouflaged Ukrainian troop deployment points in Zaporizhia Oblast using Grad MLRS.
Russian Sever group drone operators destroyed sheltered Ukrainian personnel in Sumy Oblast.
Russian MoD claims air defence forces intercepted and destroyed 505 Ukrainian aircraft-type UAVs over multiple Russian regions, Crimea, and the Black and Azov seas overnight.
Russian MoD claims its drone operators destroyed a Ukrainian uncrewed ground vehicle depot and ammunition warehouse in the Dobropillia direction.
Russian MoD claims Russian forces struck port infrastructure and hit a cargo ship delivering military cargo in the port of Mykolaiv using UAVs.
Russian MoD claims Russian forces conducted a missile strike against a bridge over the Oskil river near Petrivka in the Kupiansk direction.
Russian MoD claims Russian Aerospace Forces used four UMPB guided glide munitions to destroy temporary deployment points of the Ukrainian 129th Separate Heavy Mechanized Brigade near Prykolotne.
Russian MoD claims Russian Aerospace Forces dropped two FAB-3000 glide bombs on positions of the Ukrainian 65th Separate Mechanized Brigade near Orikhiv.
Russian MoD claims Russian air-launched missiles destroyed a stronghold of the Ukrainian 128th Separate Heavy Mechanized Brigade near Kushuhum.
Russian MoD claims units of the Sever group of forces took control of the settlement of Kyyanytsya in Sumy Oblast.
Russian MoD claims its drone operators destroyed six Ukrainian relay antennas in the Dobropillia direction.
Russian MoD claims Russian forces captured Kostiantynivka and are securing assigned sectors across the city.
Russian MoD claims Russian aviation struck a Ukrainian UAV command post in the port area of Kherson.
Russian MoD claims its combat engineers destroyed an unexploded Ukrainian strike FPV drone in the Krasny Liman direction.
Russian MoD claims its assault groups are advancing deeper into Dobropillia against surrounded Ukrainian formations.
Russian MoD claims Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship carrying dual-use goods for the Ukrainian Armed Forces in the port of Chornomorsk using UAVs.
Russian MoD claims Russian forces struck a dry cargo ship at sea en route to the port of Odesa carrying military supplies using UAVs.
Russian MoD claims airborne forces of the Tsentr group are clearing city blocks and eliminating Ukrainian personnel, command posts, and drone positions in Dobropillia.
Russian MoD claims air defence forces intercepted and destroyed 62 Ukrainian UAVs over multiple Russian regions, Crimea, and the Black Sea during the day.
Russian Su-34 crew carried out air strikes using aerial bombs against temporary deployment sites and manpower of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in the zone of responsibility of the Sever grouping.
Russian Sever grouping units took control of the settlement of Kyyanytsya in Sumy Oblast.
Russian Aerospace Forces struck concentrations of Ukrainian manpower and equipment in Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia Oblasts.
Russian paratroopers of the Tsentr grouping engaged Ukrainian formations in Dobropillia.
Russian aviation struck a Ukrainian UAV control point in the port zone of Kherson after reconnaissance drone adjustment.
Russian Vostok grouping Grad artillery struck disguised Ukrainian temporary deployment points in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.
Russian forces delivered a missile strike against a bridge over the Oskil River in the Kupiansk direction.
Russian Tsentr grouping drone operators destroyed six Ukrainian relay antennas in the Dobropillia direction.
